pricing.title: Per-tool upload and usage limits
pricing.text:
Per-tool upload and usage limits

Server submissions count as one daily operation per run. Browser-local processing does not use the daily server allowance. AI requests share the same daily allowance; no separate page or word allowance is currently published. Provider, memory, and processing-time constraints may apply.
